findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.comment: Observed an insect glue trap stored in very close contact with a stack of clean pans (in cabinet across from triple sink). Shown to the PIC and the trap was discarded to correct the violation. Ensure that insect traps are never stored in areas where food or food contact surfaces can be exposed to contamination.
findings.citation_text: 6-202.13 Insect Control Devices, Design and Installation. (A) Insect control devices that are used to electrocute or stun flying insects shall be designed to retain the insect within the device. (B) Insect control devices shall be installed so that: (1) The devices are not located over a FOOD preparation area; and (2) Dead insects and insect fragments are prevented from being impelled onto or falling on exposed FOOD; clean EQUIPMENT, UTENSILS, and LINENS; and unwrapped SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices
findings.citation_text:
5-205.15 A leak was observed at the plumbing under the middle basin of the 3 part sink. PIC noted a work order was placed. PIC checked with maintenance recently regarding time frame for repairs, and maintenance noted they are really busy at the moment. The leak at the 3 part sink is not considered an emergency and not a priority. In the meantime until the plumbing is repaired, staff have a bucket under the plumbing to catch leaking wastewater. The bucket is emptied daily as needed and was observed clean at the time of inspection.
A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.comment:
Sanitizer bucket being used to clean tables tested at 0 ppm quat. Bucket was remade to 400 ppm quat during the inspection to correct the violation. Make sure that you are testing sanitizer buckets once made to ensure that it tests at 200-400 ppm quat.
750-810b Moist cloths used for wiping food spills on kitchenware and food-contact surfaces shall be clean and rinsed frequently in one of the permitted sanitizing solutions. See Section 750.820e.   These cloths shall be stored in a proper sanitizing solution between uses.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment:
CORRECTED> Observed several individual containers of bean salad prepared on site on 1-5-15 in the reach in cooler. Items were discarded during inspection to correct the violation. Seven day hold periods were discussed during inspection. If facility prepares mayonnaise based salads, they should be date marked with the date of preparation and held no longer than 7 days maximum. Commercially prepared and packaged deli salads are exempt from this, as discussed.
750-151(a) Refrigerated potentially hazardous food held at the establishment more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked with the ate or day by which the food shall be consumed, sold, or discarded. Maximum holding time at 41°F is 7 days. Properly date mark food and do not hold longer than 7 days.
